name: Delirium 1
description: A disease that confuses the enemy for 12.  Each hit they deal has a 25% chance to strike themselves instead (including spells).  Drains 0.25% of their max health per second, and during it's first 7s will spread the disease to those directly beside them.  Never takes an ally below 1 health. Pure Only.

name: Gangrene 1
description: Rot that slows the enemy's attack by 30% for 30s.  In it's first 7s it spreads to those directly beside them.  It drains only when they move or land a hit and the drain is based on your INT and spell damage.

name: Inoculation 1
description: Wards you or an ally for 60s, absorbing the next disease or the next harmful effect.  Gain 15 ichor when it triggers.

name: Lance the Bubo 1
description: Consumes every disease on an enemy (other's disease and own cloud included), for a burst of 11,610 damage, plus 40% of what each disease had left to deal.  Pays 10 ichor for each disease consumed.

name: Leech Jar 1
description: Hangs a jar on your group for 2s.  While it hands, anything rotting within 4 tiles, heals them for half of what the disease takes.  Healing past full becomes a shield, up to half of their maximum health.  Does not affect yourself.

name: Pestilence 1
description: Drains the enemy for 0.8% of it's max health each second for 30s (less against bosses), and feeds your ichor.  In it's first 7s, it spreads to those directly beside them.  Allies can catch it.

name: Plague Cloud 1
description: A cloud of rot that clings to your target, and follows them for 15s, infecting anything standing within 3 tiles.  The rot lasts 15s, drains health each second and eats their armour (worsening from 5 AC to 15).  It also cuts healing received by 30%.  If the target dies (or leaves), the cloud will settle where it last stood.  If the target dies it will burst onto nearby enemies

name: Quarantine 1
description: Seals off a 5 tile zone where you stand for 20s.  Disease cannot spread across the edge in any direction, though death bursts and plague clouds still reach over it.  Diseases inside will hit 25% harder and pays 50% more ichor.  Ends if you die.

name: Transfusion 1
description: An instant heal on yourself or one ally for 3200, plus 45 for every point of WIS.

name: Triage 1
description: Stripes every PD disease, including poison, miasma, burn, amnesia and slow from you and your group within 12 tiles.  Costs 10 ichor, plus 5 for each effect it removes.

name: Virulent Plague Cloud
description: A cloud of rot that clings to your target, and follows them for 15s, infecting anything standing within 3 tiles.  The rot lasts 15s, drains health each second and eats their armour (worsening from 5 AC to 15).  It also cuts healing received by 30%.  If the target dies (or leaves), the cloud will settle where it last stood.  If the target dies it will burst onto nearby enemies.  Every point of health it takes, is threat pulled off of you, and handed to the group member nearest the target.  Pure Only.
